title: Sweet Basil (Ocimum basilicum L.)
description: High-value aromatic herb precision engineering guide covering LED PPFD spectrum steering, essential oil (eugenol/linalool) accumulation, and tip-burn prevention in vertical hydroponics.
image_caption: Controlled hydroponic NFT basil canopy under high-PPFD blue-enriched LED spectrum.
overview: Sweet Basil (Ocimum basilicum L.) is an economically vital culinary and medicinal herb requiring high Daily Light Integral (DLI > 14 mol/m²/day) and warm root-zone temperatures (21-24°C). In closed hydroponic systems (NFT/DWC), basil is exceptionally susceptible to tip-burn caused by localized calcium (Ca²⁺) starvation in rapidly expanding apical meristems under low canopy airflow. Precise control of boundary layer thickness (rb) combined with elevated substrate Ca:K ratios (1:1.2) is essential to maximize essential oil yield (eugenol and linalool) without leaf necrosis.

climate_strategy.strategy: Maintain day temperature at 25.5°C and night temperature at 21.0°C (DIF +4.5°C). Keep ambient VPD between 0.85 and 1.15 kPa. Deploy micro-vectored vertical air velocity of 0.35 m/s across canopy crowns to thin leaf boundary layer and stimulate transpirational calcium uptake.

crop_steering.intro: Photomorphogenic and calcium transport steering matrix for maximum essential oil density.

vegetative_triggers.irrigation: DLI Target: 12 mol m⁻² d⁻¹, Target EC: 1.6 mS/cm, Drain: 20%

generative_triggers.irrigation: DLI Target: 16 mol m⁻² d⁻¹, Target EC: 2.2 mS/cm, Blue fraction: 25% (Essential Oil Steering)

fertigation.intro: Nutrient solution formulation tailored for Lamiaceae essential oil synthesis.
fertigation.vegetative_phase: Supply Calcium Nitrate [PubChem CID 24963] (Ca 4.0 mM, NO3⁻ 11.0 mM) and Monopotassium Phosphate [PubChem CID 516951] (P 1.2 mM, K 4.5 mM) to prevent apical tip-burn.
fertigation.generative_phase: Enhance Magnesium Sulfate [PubChem CID 24083] (Mg 2.0 mM, SO4²⁻ 2.0 mM) and Iron-EDDHA (Fe 35 µM) to support elevated terpene synthase enzyme kinetics.

references.text: Light spectrum and VPD regulation of essential oil yield and calcium nutrition in hydroponic basil.
